description.value: Frequency once per 10 minutes You alter the type of energy output of your magic. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with no duration that has an elemental trait (air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood) and deals one type of damage, replace the elemental trait with a different elemental trait and the damage it deals with one of the damage types corresponding to the selected trait: air (electricity or sonic), earth (bludgeoning or piercing), fire (fire), metal (acid or slashing), water (cold), wood (poison).
